name: FMCats Wisconsin III 2024

venue.name: Private Residence
venue.address: Address will be provided to registered competitors

information: **There is no 3x3 at this competition.** If you are looking for a competition with more standard events, please check out [Pyraminx in Pewaukee 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PyraminxinPewaukee2024). This competition will have two cats roaming around the venue. Only one guest per competitor is permitted. Please consider coming without a guest as spectator seating will be limited.
